'''2010 Yavin 4 Regionals Mike d'Amboise DS Tatooine Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike d'Amboise]] at [[2010 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine Occupation|SE-D-tatooineoccupation.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Mike d'Ambrose
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
